title: Fairness in LLM Toxicity Detection
summary: Evaluated attributional bias in LLM toxicity detection using counterfactual author identities, measuring attribution shift, false-positive disparity, alignment bias, calibration, and differences between GPT-OSS-120B and LLaMA-3.1-8B.

title: Advanced Computer Graphics Projects
summary: Implemented a PyTorch path tracer with camera, lighting, reflection, refraction, path-tracing, and inverse-rendering components; also evaluated Nerfacto robustness under noise, color jitter, and blur using PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS.

title: Parallel Programming Framework Comparison
summary: Compared OpenMP, Intel TBB, C++ Parallel STL, OpenMPI, and Intel MPI on NAS Parallel Benchmarks and SPEC HPC 2021, profiling scalability, NUMA behavior, synchronization, communication, and runtime bottlenecks.

title: Adaptive SpMM Scheduling Simulator
summary: A distributed sparse matrix multiplication simulator for heterogeneous accelerator nodes, modeling SIGMA, GAMMA, and OuterSPACE dataflows with matrix analysis, Greedy/LPT scheduling, window-based task scheduling, and utilization metrics.

title: CalcuLatency
summary: A replication of CalcuLatency for detecting proxy and VPN usage through latency measurements and user geolocation; implemented the backend, ping/TCP measurement tools, and analytical pipeline.

title: Peykar Cyber-Range
summary: A cyber-range platform developed at S4Lab to prepare security specialists through realistic challenges; contributed to core infrastructure, backend APIs, and challenge design.

title: Arno: Service Requesting System
summary: An online service-requesting platform with customer, provider, and admin panels, designed with the Unified Process and object-oriented design principles.

title: Health Monitoring System
summary: An embedded system that measures a patient's SpO2, heart rate, ECG, and body/environment temperature on a Raspberry Pi + Arduino, with a mobile app and central server.

title: Multicore Computing Projects
summary: GPU and CPU parallel kernels: a Sobel edge-detection filter and green-screen replacement in CUDA/SIMD, and an N-Queens solver in OpenMP.

title: CMinus Compiler
summary: A full compiler for the C-minus language (lexer, parser, semantic analyzer, and code generator) written in pure Python.

title: PintOS
summary: A multi-phase operating systems project on PintOS (based on Berkeley CS162) implementing user programs, threads, and file-system features in C.

title: Telenurse: Healthcare Logistics
summary: A logistics platform connecting patients who need at-home nursing with providers, built as a System Analysis & Design project using Scrum.

title: Computer Networks Course Projects (P2P Network & P4)
summary: Built a decentralized binary-tree peer-to-peer chat network from the IP through application layers, and implemented UDP, TCP, and access-control-list behavior on a programmable switch using P4.

title: Computer Architecture Course Project
summary: Designed and tested a multicycle CPU in Quartus, plus cache-configuration experiments in gem5.

title: Duelyst
summary: A clone of the Duelyst turn-based strategy game built for the Advanced Programming course using Java and JavaFX.

title: Artificial Intelligence Course Projects
summary: Local search (hill climbing, simulated annealing), genetic programming for symbolic regression, decision trees, SVMs, and multilayer perceptrons.

title: Realtime Systems Project
summary: A real-time clock-management system using the threading capabilities of Real-Time Java, with a minimal Swing GUI.

title: AML Microarray Analysis
summary: Acute Myeloid Leukemia microarray analysis using the R programming language for the Introduction to Bioinformatics course.

title: Rosalind Bioinformatics Problems
summary: Solutions to Rosalind bioinformatics problems from the Bioinformatics Algorithms book, implemented in C++.
